profile: cluster assignment: The process of assigning a data point x_p to a cluster. It is defined by the condition that x_p belongs to cluster k⋆ when a_p equals the argument minimizing the squared Euclidean distance between x_p and cluster centers c_k. Therefore, the selected cluster is the one with the nearest centroid.

claims.claim: Cluster assignment is the process of assigning a data point x_p to a cluster.
A data point x_p is assigned to cluster k⋆ if a_p = argmin_{k=1,...,K} ||x_p - c_k||^2, i.e., the cluster center minimizing the squared Euclidean distance.
